steps.content: So she wasn't lying when she claimed to be a Northwild know-it-all. You listen as Shuang'er recounts the tale of the manor's previous masters. The Medical Sage couple had a daughter late, and the girl was cursed with frail health. Later, the manor fell into seclusion as they devoted themselves to caring for her.

The martial world had almost forgotten about Northsnow Manor, yet these sudden rumors of a secret codex have drawn minds back to that chaotic era when Northwild had no heroes. The Medical Sage couple were true champions of those troubled times, so it's hardly surprising the manor could achieve such grandeur.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: See that? Everyone's heading to that building in the center. That must be the meeting hall... Follow me! I've already scouted the route. We'll circle around behind the covered bridge. I guarantee no one will spot us!
You two walk in single file, hugging close to the corridor pillars as you creep forward. From Shuang'er's practiced movements, she's clearly no stranger to this kind of sneaking around.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Aren't there any guards or servants in this place?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: What if... they're all hiding in the shadows, watching us?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: We wouldn't be able to creep around with our butts sticking out like this in that case, would we?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Maybe this manor master is an unusual character who doesn't trust people. Maybe she has set up a bunch of hidden traps instead... Ow!
She suddenly lets out a yelp, and you instinctively tense up.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Don't, don't move! Something's... poking me! Something sharp... on my butt!

Is there really a hidden trap? You turn around cautiously, only to meet two pairs of round, beady black eyes. Two chubby little birds are tilting their heads at you, and one is even tugging at Shuang'er's clothes with its beak.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: They're yelling at us! They're scolding us for not using the front door, calling us sneaky thieves!
You don't speak bird, but you do notice that each bird has a thin bamboo tube tied to its leg. You reach out to remove them and find two plain memos rolled up inside.
Northsnow Manor has no gates. The winds escort the willing guests in, who choose their own fate.
Skinny, elegant handwriting in tranquil black ink. You lift your head to see snow blanketing the courtyard and the quiet buildings. The entire manor seems to have anticipated your arrival.
